tasks.title: Rust: Canvas::draw_image + render DocxBlock::Image (DM-7), emu->px sizing, image_render_tests
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 2 item 1 — Images (ORM-04 Phase A, tagged DM-7). Today image rendering is a literal no-op: wo-renderer-wasm/src/layout.rs line ~58 has `DocxBlock::Image(_) => {}` (in the paragraph loop) and line ~498 has `DocxBlock::Image(_image) => { cursor_y += 20.0 * PT_TO_PX; }` (the "placeholder for now" in the block layout loop). wo-ooxml ALREADY parses image bytes: `DocxImage { bytes: Vec<u8>, width_emu, height_emu, wrap_mode }` (core/crates/wo-ooxml/src/model.rs ~line 888), reachable via `docx.images()` and the per-block `DocxBlock::Image(DocxImage)`. wo-raster already has a decoder: `core/crates/wo-raster/src/decoder.rs` — `ImageDecoder::decode(data) -> Result<RasterImage, String>`, `RasterImage::as_rgba_bytes()`, `:new(width,height,fill)`, plus scaling where it exists. TASKS: (1) In `core/crates/wo-renderer/src/canvas.rs` add `pub fn draw_image(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32, width: f32, height: f32, rgba: &[u8], img_w: u32, img_h: u32)` that blits the RGBA bytes into the canvas pixel buffer at the target rect (nearest-neighbor or bilinear scale to fit), respecting the current clip/transform where trivial; if wo-renderer lacks a pixel buffer abstraction for this, add a minimal `blit_rgba` on whatever surface Canvas holds (look at how draw_rect sets pixels). (2) In wo-renderer-wasm/src/layout.rs replace BOTH no-op sites: for `DocxBlock::Image`, decode `bytes` via wo-raster `ImageDecoder::decode`, compute the target rect from width_emu/height_emu (1 emu = 1/914400 inch; PT_TO_PX is already defined — convert emu->pt->px), reserve the cursor space (advance by the rendered height like a block), and push a render command so the image actually lands on the page raster. (3) In wo-renderer-wasm/src/canvas_bridge.rs ensure the image pixels get into the exported ImageData the page already produces (the bridge already exports ImageData from the pixel buffer — make draw_image feed into the same buffer). (4) Add wo-raster (and if needed the `image` crate) as dependencies of wo-renderer (Cargo.toml) — check the workspace deps in the root Cargo.toml first and reuse them; do NOT add a new external crate not already in the workspace. (5) NEW test module wo-renderer-wasm/src/image_render_tests.rs (`mod image_render_tests;` in lib.rs under #[cfg(test)]): a plain #[test] that builds a minimal docx (parse a tiny docx string containing one inline image via OoxmlParser, or construct the model directly) and asserts layout produces a page whose pixel buffer differs from a no-image baseline in the region where the image should be (i.e. pixels were blitted), plus a second test asserting the emu->px sizing math. Baseline green: `cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib` currently 189 passing — stay green. NO wasm signature changes. scope: canvas.rs, wo-renderer-wasm layout.rs, canvas_bridge.rs, wo-renderer Cargo.toml, image_render_tests.rs, plan/oo-port/.
tasks.acceptance: Canvas::draw_image exists and blits RGBA; both DocxBlock::Image no-op sites in layout.rs render (decode via wo-raster, emu->px rect, cursor advances); image_render_tests.rs has >=2 plain tests incl. one proving pixels differ from no-image baseline; cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib green (baseline 189).

tasks.title: Rust: extract Shaper + shaped-run line breaking (Phase B), replaces char_advance
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 2 item 2 — Shaping + text layout (Phase B). rustybuzz + swash are already dependencies of wo-renderer (Cargo.toml) and `Canvas::draw_text` (core/crates/wo-renderer/src/canvas.rs ~line 634) already does swash-based glyph shaping for single runs. Extract it into a reusable shape engine and replace the current `char_advance`-based line breaking (search canvas.rs / text.rs for `char_advance` and line-breaking loops) with shaped-run breaking so kerning pairs, ligature widths and non-Latin scripts (logical-order clusters) measure correctly. TASKS: (1) NEW module `core/crates/wo-renderer/src/shaping.rs` (`pub mod shaping;` in lib.rs): `pub struct Shaper<'a> { library: &'a FontLibrary, ... }` with `pub fn shape(&self, font: &FontKey/Handle, size_pt: f32, text: &str) -> Result<Vec<ShapedRun>, String>` reusing the swash code from draw_text (extract, don't duplicate); `pub struct ShapedRun { text: String, glyphs: Vec<GlyphPos>, advance: f32, direction: TextDirection }` (define a small TextDirection/enum or reuse existing), plus `shaped_advance` that sums run advances. (2) NEW module `core/crates/wo-renderer/src/textlayout.rs` (`pub mod textlayout;`): `pub fn break_lines(shaper, font, size, width_pt, text) -> Vec<LayoutLine>` that segments text by runs (using wo-unicode tables if helpful for script/bidi boundaries — wo-unicode workspace crate is available), shapes each run, and breaks at the largest shaped prefix whose advance fits `width_pt` WITHOUT splitting a shaped cluster mid-glyph (carry to next line); the old `char_advance` path in canvas.rs/text.rs should delegate here (or be replaced by a call to break_lines) so displayed and measured metrics agree. (3) Rewire `Canvas::draw_text` (and `draw_text_weighted` if it does its own layout) to consume break_lines output; behavior for existing tests must not regress (baseline: `cargo test -p wo-renderer --lib` + `cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib` currently 189 passing total). (4) NEW test module wo-renderer/src/shaping_tests.rs with plain #[test]s: a Latin string with a known kerning pair (e.g. "AV") has shaped advance != sum of naive glyph advances (proves Shaper actually shapes); a long unbreakable word wraps to the next line at exactly width_pt; a string with a cluster (test with a composed char or CJK contiguous run) never splits mid-glyph; empty/whitespace-only strings yield zero lines of glyphs. NO wasm signature changes. scope: wo-renderer/src/{shaping.rs,textlayout.rs,canvas.rs,text.rs,lib.rs,shaping_tests.rs}, wo-renderer/Cargo.toml, plan/oo-port/.
tasks.acceptance: wo-renderer/src/shaping.rs has pub struct Shaper + shape() -> Vec<ShapedRun>; textlayout.rs has break_lines -> Vec<LayoutLine>; draw_text consumes break_lines; char_advance line breaking replaced; shaping_tests.rs has >=3 tests (kerning advance != naive sum, long-word wrap, cluster never splits); cargo test -p wo-renderer --lib + -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib green.

tasks.title: Rust: DOCX fields engine — fldSimple + fldChar begin/separate/end, gap_fields_roundtrip

tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 2 item 4 (second engine) — DOCX style-chain resolution. wo-ooxml currently stores styles as a flat bag (search model.rs for `DocxStyles`/`styles:`/`docDefaults` — the parser has 5 references to docDefaults/latentStyles/pStyle but no resolution).
